title: Building tomorrow
blurb: How the day gets built, and what happens when it falls apart by nine.
asks: How does tomorrow's board get built, and who builds it?
sample:
Voicemail, 7:14am:

Hey it's Tom — Jarrod called out sick this morning, so we're a man down. The Millbrook Road job has to happen today, they're already rescheduled once. Can somebody call the Fourth Street customer and push them to Thursday? Number's 229-555-0163. Thanks.

steps.name: Rebuild it when somebody calls out
steps.note: This is the one that eats the morning.

steps.name: Ring the customers you had to move
